selection_rationale: Both lemmas were reviewed as C2A class-only entries in the pre-v11 cohort and are already admitted by the generic C2A activation architecture. Stage 1P authorizes class-level past only for 3pl, so 2pl remains an untouched capability gap. The two target lemmas are selected here before any external lookup of their 2pl past surfaces.
notes: This file intentionally contains no target surface answers. Its purpose is to create a Git-verifiable pre-answer checkpoint for the next blind C2A past-person experiment.
